title: Dimension of a finite type domain over a field equals the transcendence degree of its fraction field
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $A$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] which is an integral domain. Let $K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$ be its fraction field. Then the Krull dimension of $A$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] and the transcendence degree of $K$ over $k$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree] are finite and equal: $$\dim A=\operatorname{trdeg}_k K.$$ Moreover, for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset A$, the local ring $A_{\mathfrak m}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] has this same dimension.
